source_kind: Original Odia poem in local edition archive; not a translation

title: KBL · ପବନ · Original Odia recital
lyrics:
[Spoken word]
କାହାରି ପାଖରେ
ଅଟକି ଯାଏନି କେବେ
ଅନଳ ଭିତରୁ ବି ବାହାରି ଆସେ
ତୁମ
ହାତର
ବଂଶୀରେ
ବାଟ ହୁଡ଼ି ବସେ
ରହିଯାଏ
ଯେତେବେଳେ
ତୁମ ଓଠର ସ୍ପର୍ଶ
ତୁମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିମାନ
ଛୁଇଁ ଚାଲିଥାଆନ୍ତି
ମତେ
ପୁନର୍ଜନ୍ମ ଲଭେ ।।
[End]
style: Spoken-word ballad, warm, resonant female Odia voice in a comfortable natural register with natural pronunciation, slow soulful narration and expressive emotional pauses. Voice intimate, clear and prominently foregrounded. Very soft, sparse piano chords and barely audible ambient pads underneath; occasional gentle flute between spoken phrases, delicate distant string swells, almost imperceptible percussion. Spacious cinematic reverb on the accompaniment, lighter reverb on the voice to preserve clarity. A subtle 70 BPM pulse supports free, natural speech. Restrained gradual build; accompaniment stays quiet throughout and gently recedes whenever the narrator speaks. Preserve every word without repetition or added lyrics. Let connected thoughts flow through the short printed lines; use natural Odia phrase-level pauses.
exclude: EDM, heavy dance beats, aggressive percussion, loud backing music, dense orchestration, overpowering bass, dramatic drops, theatrical belting, excessive vocal runs, melodic singing, chanting, rap, choir, backing vocals, vocoder, autotune effects, chopped vocals, heavy vocal echo
rationale: Short original Odia verse with wind, flute and touch imagery. Carry the latest female vocal and quiet accompaniment direction forward. Preserve every source word, punctuation and line break; expressive phrasing must be auditioned.
